title: status_snapshot picks the oldest matching job instead of the newest
description: hosted_publications.status_snapshot iterates reversed(store.jobs(...)), but the S3 console store already returns jobs newest first, so within its 20-job window it selects the OLDEST matching job's result. Found during record-lake S2c (PR #105), behaviour deliberately left unchanged there. Fix: select the newest matching job explicitly (by timestamp) with a spec covering both store orderings.
